shared_elements: human or anthropomorphic figures shown frontally/in profile
outspread wings flanking a central element
symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
carved relief with incised linear detail
headdress or crown on a figure
beaded/banded ornament rendered as rows of short strokes
justification: Both surfaces show a symmetrical, axially centred composition in which a central emblem or figure is flanked by outspread wing-like forms, and both use low relief with fine incised lines for ornament such as beaded collars or feather rows. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a rectangular tablet divided into registers with a row of small profile figures and many lines of sign-writing beneath a winged disc, while B is a single large frontal figure with an elaborate multi-lobed crown and skirt, with no registers, no writing, and no processional scene.
